environment: Concordium Testnet; local loopback buyer, seller, and facilitator services

workflow.result: Rejected a seller badge other than the locally configured seller before any payment request.
Configured seller badge, card hash, and registered wallet check passed.
Live exact-payment quote passed the fixed Testnet/payee/sponsor/expiry policy.
Fresh nonce, balance, chain parameters, signer key match, unsigned transfer, and digest were prepared.
Approval was bound to the displayed signing digest after fresh identity, quote, and chain-state checks.
Facilitator confirmed finalization and a second Testnet gRPC read matched sender, recipient, amount, and native CCD. Seller returned paid=true.

receipt.qualification: The original receipt flag was corrected by an appended hash-linked note: finality came from a second facilitator gRPC read; no separate explorer API read was made.

limits: This is one successful configured Testnet demonstration, not proof of production readiness or general reliability.
The receipt log is local and hash-linked; it is not externally anchored or immutable.
The CCDScan link is provided for a human independent inspection; explorer contents were not captured by this run.
Buyer and sponsor account addresses and credentials are intentionally omitted from this sanitized artifact.
